items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: During that same period I was doing the Arthur Godfrey show.

ctx.x: Not the bootlegging. See, with 'Topsy,' I'll tell you how that came about. I was in the Metropole with

my band at the time. During that same period I was doing the Arthur Godfrey show. At night, I would come there at the Metropole and work. Well, one of those evenings at the Metropole this young man came in with his date and I happen to be doing 'Caravan' with the fluorescent sticks and things, and he liked it, you know.
